systemInstruction: You are working inside the Jeevandata codebase owned by Aditya. Keep the brand name as 'Jeevandata' everywhere unless explicitly instructed otherwise. Always use Tailwind CSS for all new UI work and maintain consistency with existing project patterns. Never remove existing comments. Never modify, delete, refactor, rename, or clean up existing business logic unless explicitly requested. Before making any code changes, you MUST first read and understand the codebase memory file at jeevandata/memory.md. Follow the established architecture, folder structure, coding conventions, naming standards, TypeScript patterns, linting rules, testing strategy, environment configuration, and design system already used by the project. Prefer extending existing modules rather than creating duplicate implementations. Preserve backward compatibility whenever possible. Generate production-ready code only.
projectSpecificRules: Use Next.js App Router only — do NOT use Pages Router
Use TypeScript strictly — no `any` types allowed (enforced by ESLint)
Use Tailwind CSS v3 utilities with the project's custom theme colors (jeevandata-50 through jeevandata-950, semantic HSL variables)
Use existing Radix UI primitives for accessible components (dialog, select, toast, tabs, tooltip, dropdown-menu, avatar)
Use TanStack Query (React Query) for server state management
Use Zustand with devtools middleware for client state management
Use class-variance-authority (CVA) + tailwind-merge (cn utility) for component variants
Follow existing NestJS module architecture: each domain has its own module with controller, service, and module file
Use Prisma ORM for all database access — not raw SQL
Use Socket.IO for real-time bidirectional communication (session updates, transcription streaming)
Use Zod schemas from @jeevandata/shared-schemas for all API input validation
Use shared types from @jeevandata/shared-types and shared utils from @jeevandata/shared-utils
Never directly store raw face images or Aadhaar numbers — store only normalized 512-dimensional embeddings and SHA-256 hashes
All patient-related operations must respect the consentGranted flag
Use JWT authentication via Passport.js (@nestjs/passport + passport-jwt)
Use @nestjs/throttler for rate limiting
Use pino for structured JSON logging in backend
Write tests using Jest with ts-jest for backend modules
Frontend hooks go in apps/frontend/src/hooks/ — follow the existing pattern (useCamera, useFaceDetection, etc.)
Frontend services go in apps/frontend/src/services/ — separate files for api.ts, socket.ts, db.ts
Frontend stores go in apps/frontend/src/stores/ using Zustand (face-store.ts, session-store.ts)
Use Dexie (IndexedDB) for offline-first patient and session caching
All face detection/geometry logic goes in apps/frontend/src/lib/ (face-embedding.ts, face-geometry.ts)
Prefer MobileNet/WebGPU delegate for MediaPipe, fallback to CPU
Use clsx + tailwind-merge (cn helper) for conditional class names — never string concatenation
Use lucide-react for all SVG icons — never raw SVG strings
Docker services are defined in docker-compose.yml — always use docker compose up -d for local infra
